question: does the opening observation already narrow the field, and what does the demonstrator itself spend? (THEORY-PHASE.md §9 items 1 and 2)
scientific_acceptance_policy: measurement only; it trains nothing and gates no run

teacher_target_leakage.consequence: a commit target at an unlicensed state is derived from inst.truth and cannot be justified by visible evidence; STEP-1 §5.2 forbids supervising it
teacher_target_leakage.probe_policy: ascending probe id, truth-blind; a stand-in for a learner spending badly

truth_blind_ceiling.bound_direction: upper bound: no adaptive truth-blind policy can exceed a hindsight-chosen subset
truth_blind_ceiling.search: exhaustive over probe subsets within budget; scored in hindsight

truth_blind_identification.bound_direction: upper bound on probes; one fixed policy, not the truth-blind optimum
truth_blind_identification.policy: ascending probe id, truth-blind, until licensed or no affordable probe remains

truth_blind_optimum.interpretation: the task is very nearly solvable without truth; the teacher's lower probe count is a privilege of knowing the answer, so imitating its cost profile caps the learner below this ceiling
